resources.string: Automatic follows the system language. Applies right away, also to PDFs and messages.
Settings saved, but the monthly fixed cost only counts toward the price when print hours per month are filled in.
The monthly fixed cost only counts toward the price when print hours per month are filled in.
Charged for the minutes you enter in each quote.
Removing the print, removing supports, sanding, painting, packing. It adds to the price at your hourly rate, with no margin on top. Leave it at zero to not charge for labor.
Add up the hours of all your printers.
Rent, internet, subscriptions and packaging don't show up in any specific part, but you pay for them every month.
The amount is divided by the month's print hours, and each part pays its share. Leave it at zero to skip.
Failure reserve for when a print fails.

Applies to everything you spend again to redo the part (material, energy, maintenance, machine payback, fixed cost, labor and finishing). Only the admin cost is left out, because a model that's already made doesn't need to be made again.
Percentage of the material for sanding and painting.
If you already count that time in the minutes of each quote, leave it at 0 so you don't charge twice.
Percentage taken out of the sale, like sales tax or VAT.
Flat monthly taxes or fees don't go here. Put them in the monthly fixed cost.
The parts in an order never go out for less than this.
Services and shipping are left out. Leave it at 0 to skip.
How much extra you charge when you mark an order as rush.
At 0, the option doesn't even show up in the quote.
The most accurate way: the bill already includes taxes and surcharges.
The surcharge is on your power bill or on your utility's website.
Enter how much of your print hours fall in each period. The app takes the average.
Fill in the fields to calculate.
Where the sale happens and how much it takes out of what you get: Etsy, eBay, Amazon, card.

You pick the channel in each quote, and the price goes up enough to keep your margin. Marketplace and payment method go here together on purpose: adding Etsy's fee to the card fee would charge twice, because the marketplace already includes payment processing.
No channels yet: every quote goes out as a direct sale, with no fee.
Etsy and eBay charge a small fixed amount per item sold, on top of the percentage.
This channel uses price tiers: the fee and fixed amount of each tier apply.
When the fee changes with the price of the part, add the tiers.
They replace the fee and fixed amount above.

%1$d price tiers active: they replace the fee and fixed amount above.

resources.string: The tier up to %1$s became "Above that", and its limit was dropped.
Fill in the limit of every tier except the last one.
The tier limit must be greater than zero.
Tier limits must go up from one tier to the next.
The tier fee is not a number. E.g. 20 or 4.99.
The tier fee must be between 0% and 100%.
The tier fixed amount is not a number.
The tier fixed amount can't be negative.
Quotes already saved keep the fee they had. Catalog products on this channel will ask for a new channel when you update the price.
Goes in the PDF header. A PNG with a transparent background looks best.
Couldn't read that image. Try a PNG or JPG.
The saved logo wasn't found in the app folder. Choose it again.
Shown in the PDF and the image, so clients can reach you.
PDFs and the WhatsApp image carry a discreet "Made with 3DReport" line in the corner, away from your name and the price, with a link to the website in the PDF.
That's how the app, which is free, reaches other sellers.
Print time in the PDF and message
Print time is the machine time of the order (e.g. "6 h 30 min").
It helps the client understand the work, but it can also become an argument for a discount, so it starts off.
Client name in the PDF ("For: Maria")
The PDF says "Valid until" the issue date plus these days, so a client who comes back months later can't ask for the old price.
Leave it at 0 to hide it.
On automatic, a dark part gets a light background and the others a dark one.
Use a number of days from 0 to %1$d (0 removes the line)
Select at least one option: watermark or footer.
Sample quote, with what's in the form right now (even if unsaved).
Couldn't generate the preview. Try again.
A template saves the name and the look of the PDF. Your logo and contact always stay the same.
Couldn't save the template. Try again.
Light, dark or the same as the system. Applies right away.
The currency of new quotes: symbol and format of amounts on screen, in the PDF and when copying and pasting.
It doesn't affect the calculation. Each saved quote stays in the currency it was made in. Applies right away, no need to save.
Your quotes, clients, catalogs, photos and model files stay only on this computer.
The backup bundles all of it into one .zip file, to keep somewhere else or take to another machine.
No backup made on this computer yet.
Make one backup a day when the app opens (keeps the last 7)
Pick a Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox folder, and the copy goes to the cloud on its own.
Couldn't write the backup. Check that the folder exists and has space, then try again.
The folder doesn't exist yet: it's created on the first automatic backup.
Couldn't restore that backup. Nothing was changed.
Couldn't access the app's data folder.
Couldn't read that file. It may not be a valid .zip or may be corrupted.
That file doesn't look like a 3DReport backup. Nothing was changed.
That backup is from a newer version of 3DReport. Update the app to restore it. Nothing was changed.
That backup is from a version with an older data format (1.x) and doesn't open in this one. Open it with the version it was made in. Nothing was changed.
Couldn't keep a copy of the current data. Close other programs using the folder and try again. Nothing was changed.
Couldn't apply the backup. Your current data was kept.
Couldn't apply the backup, and your current data was kept in %1$s. Rename that folder back to %2$s before opening the app again.

All the app's current data (quotes, clients, catalogs, settings, photos and model files) will be replaced by the contents of "%1$s". A copy of the current data is kept automatically, and the app will close at the end to load the restored data.
The app needs to close now to load the restored data. The data that existed before was kept in:
A template saves the look of the PDF under a name.
"%1$s" will be removed. This can't be undone.
With the key, the quote PDF and the message show the Pix copy and paste code.
Key type not recognized. Check with your bank.
The key is too long for Pix.
The key has an accent or another character Pix doesn't accept.
Missing %1$s for Pix to show up in documents.
Anything in square brackets disappears when the data is missing. In [ by {prazo}], if the order has no deadline, the whole part is left out.
On new orders, the deposit is this percentage of the total. 0 means no deposit.
Use {codigo} where the code goes. Empty means no link.
Use a whole number from 0 to %1$d.
